info.name: Adyen Delete a Token for Stored Payment Details

params.name: storedPaymentMethodId
params.description: The unique identifier of the token.

params.name: shopperReference
params.description:
Your reference to uniquely identify this shopper, for example user ID or account ID. Minimum length: 3 characters.
> Your reference must not include personally identifiable information (PII), for example name or email address.

items.docs: Deletes the token identified in the path. The token can no longer be used with payment requests.
